title: This and Stranger Things s5 (red Meltie mug, Netflix on the laptop, new background)
notes: Exact replica of the Short with ONLY the background changed: a dark navy-blue wall with a night window and a warm fairy-light curtain replaces the red wall and the Christmas tree; desk, mug, laptop, props, hands, actions, framing and timing follow the original. RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3997 + lifestyle photo IMG-4084). The laptop is a green screen composited with the official Netflix logo (Netflix_2015_logo.svg from Wikimedia Commons, unchanged) centred on black in every shot, at the user's request. Unbranded wafer wrapper; Sora audio. compare.trim ignores the worst-matching 35% of the picture (the new background) when scoring and grading.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, red
product.description: the RED Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy bright red ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl/® mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular red handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a red handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

style: Vertical smartphone video filmed at night at a home desk, close camera at desk height; warm, cosy, slightly moody colour grade in a dim room with a dark navy-blue wall and warm fairy lights; hands have long light-grey manicured nails. One continuous take: no cuts, no zooms. Realistic. No on-screen text, no logos. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green.
